query: I spent this morning trying out the new neighborhood bakery down the street, their matcha croissant was so flaky and not too sweet, I even bought an extra one to save for tomorrow’s breakfast. On my way back I stopped by the pet adoption event in the community square, there was the cutest little tabby kitten that kept rubbing its head on my hand, I’m still thinking about whether I should go back and fill out an adoption application later. Oh, and the weather today is perfect, it’s sunny but with a nice cool breeze, I walked the long way home just to enjoy it. Anyway, I’m having some issues with my phone right now: my mobile network is really slow and unstable, I can’t send or receive SMS messages at all, and I’m currently traveling abroad with data roaming turned off on my plan, can you help me figure out what’s going wrong?
